title: FAIR Act ban on algorithmic rent setting
requirement: Landlords may not use a rental coordinator's algorithmic services to set rents; municipal ordinances that conflict with the act are barred.

title: Application fee cap
requirement: A landlord may not charge more than $50 to apply to lease a residential rental.
quoted_span:
A landlord, or
agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply
to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which
exceeds $50.

title: State bar on local rent control
requirement: Cities and towns may not enact or enforce rent control.

title: Broker fee rule
requirement: A broker working for the landlord may not charge the tenant a fee.
quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.

title: Ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
requirement: Selling or using algorithmic devices to set rents or occupancy levels is prohibited.
quoted_span:
Legislation
adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024. The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
